title: Vans Warped Tour
body:
Vans Warped Tour is a festival / tour Dan Frank attended. This page records the edition(s) he is documented at, with full lineups and notes, preserved from the concert log.

## Editions

| Date | Venue | City | Note |
|------|-------|------|------|
| Aug 1, 2005 | Post-Gazette Pavilion | Burgettstown, PA | Warped Tour date. Lineup included Fall Out Boy, Alexisonfire, Gogol Bordello, Hawthorne Heights. |
| Jul 27, 2006 | Post-Gazette Pavilion | Burgettstown, PA | Warped Tour date. Lineup included AFI, Rise Against, Thursday, Motion City Soundtrack, NOFX. |
| Aug 8, 2007 | Post-Gazette Pavilion | Burgettstown, PA | Warped Tour date. Lineup included Paramore, Coheed & Cambria, All Time Low, Bad Religion. |
| Jul 29, 2008 | Post-Gazette Pavilion | Burgettstown, PA | Warped Tour date. Lineup included Anberlin, All Time Low, Against Me!, 3OH!3. |
